description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Engine Mount Brackets for the LH and RH Sides for the G13A & G13BA Engine.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Left Side Engine Mount
Qty 1 – Right Side Engine Mount
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
